design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (funding_and_disbursement_disputes), rework round 3.

Draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems 3, factor_counts [6, 4, 5, 5]. Redraw fee refund (rd) takes 6, funding-month interest (fm) 4, returned-wire refund (rw) 5, dispute decision (dd) 5.

What task 1 tests. Theodore Vasquez (VA purchase of a townhouse at 5741 Tullymore Drive, Littleton, CO 80127; Larkspur Hybrid eClosing; two borrowers) asks only that his per diem overcharge dispute be decided. The decision (root, dd) is not made until the ledger carries a charge for October, the month the loan funded. That charge is the borrower's own payment (fm), which is fixed only after the ledger carries the returned-wire refund for the days Larkspur's wrong-amount wire cost (rw) and the fee ledger carries the refund of the redraw fee the Closing Disclosure charged above Larkspur's redraw schedule (rd), which is applied to the October interest. Every write is a post-closing action a funding desk takes: refunding interest for its own wire error, refunding a fee charged above its schedule, collecting the new month's interest net of what it owes the borrower, and deciding the dispute.

Round 3 changes: the round-2 redraw fee balance (a post-closing increase recovered by setoff, R2-P1/R2-F3) is replaced by a redraw fee refund (refund direction only; the redraw fee stays charged on the Closing Disclosure and is never raised after closing); dd's fee setoff and fm's late payment charge (R2-F2) are removed; rd's repeat step is a parameter and its method factor is the signer-set pricing (sessions multiply the package price; extra signers add a per-signer fee) (R2-F1); rd prices only the latest doc redraw fee charge and a charge that a reversal names is not reversed again, so its own entry is never re-priced (R2-P2; probe: rd re-evaluated after its own write gives 0.00).

FACTOR CARD rw (602.49, opening world; baseline 0.00): rw_first_lost_day M (wrong amount 410708.95 vs funding 419566.95 -> from 2026-09-24; baseline 0.00), rw_resend_days P (return 11:30 by the 12:00 cutoff -> 1; baseline 516.42), rw_rereview_days P loan (VA condition review 1; 516.42), rw_relock_days P lock (original expiration 2026-09-25 inside the span, relock request 2026-09-28 09:40 by the 16:00 desk cutoff -> 1; 516.42), rw_last_lost_day M (standard ends Wed 2026-09-30; funding wire Thu 2026-10-01 later -> 2026-09-30; 0.00). 7 x 86.07 = 602.49.

FACTOR CARD rd (60.00, opening world; baseline 100.00): rd_package_format P (Hybrid with E-SIGN consent 2026-08-31 -> 110.00; 20.00), rd_rush_addon P (latest redraw booked Mon 2026-09-14, exactly 2 business days before the 2026-09-16 signing -> 25.00; 85.00), rd_rider_addon P loan (townhouse -> 15.00; 75.00), rd_program_addenda P loan (VA -> 10.00; 70.00), rd_signer_set_pricing M loan (2 borrowers, 6 seats -> +10.00; 70.00), rd_repeat_fee P (second redraw charge -> 20.00; 80.00). Schedule 190.00 vs 250.00 charged -> 60.00. Near-miss: the first redraw (67a9c96e-f466-4173-9cac-a9ff42838346, 145.00) is not the latest and is not priced.

FACTOR CARD fm (1730.91 after rw and rd; baseline 2308.09; skipping rw 1185.48, skipping rd 1792.11): fm_setoff_per_diem P (8 open days, 86.07 > 76.39 -> 76.39; 2354.25), fm_setoff_rule M (611.12 <= 2368.09 -> set off; 2354.25), fm_payment_channel M loan (latest loan fee paid by credit_card -> percentage; 1696.97), fm_card_surcharge_rate P loan (property state CO in card_capped_states -> 2.0; 1739.39). 2368.09 - 611.12 - 60.00 = 1696.97 + 33.94 = 1730.91.

FACTOR CARD dd (77.58 after rw, rd, fm; baseline 0.00; skipping fm 689.81): dd_charge_scope M (filing names the charge; 0.00), dd_standing_days_rule M (disbursement after the charge -> 15 - 7 = 8; baseline every day, 145.46), dd_standing_day_refund P (a funding-month charge stands; 86.07 above the note's 76.39 -> 9.68; 0.00), dd_excess_interest_rate P lock (record 412000.00/7.625 vs 420858.00/6.625 -> 6.625; 77.44), dd_excess_interest_days M (filed Fri 2026-10-09, acknowledgment deadline 2026-10-16, decided 2026-10-19 -> 10 days; 77.44). 8 x 9.68 = 77.44 + 0.14 = 77.58. dd decides only per diem overcharge filings; late-funding, closing-fee and returned-wire filings stay under the dispute resolution policy by name.

PROBLEM TREE: dd <- fm (value_input, gate dd_day); fm <- rw (value_input, gate fm_open_days); fm <- rd (value_input, gate fm_fee_credit). State form throughout. Order rw, rd, fm, dd (rw and rd commute). owner=user: fm. Tools never check prerequisites.

TERMINAL: interest ledger: charge 1291.05, rw refund 602.49, fm charge 1730.91, dd refund 77.58 -> prepaid_interest_balance 2341.89; fee ledger: reversal 60.00 of 2b039f0f-66ff-4d8a-bed5-e44eab794808 -> closing_fee_balance 360.00; dispute resolved refund_issued 77.58 naming the charge.

No obligation outside the tree: the late-funding refund does not apply (disbursement after the charge); the shortfall fires only on request (the charge is priced above the note); every September day is refunded by rw or set off in fm; the 145.00 first redraw matches its schedule price; the wire fee was charged once.

VERIFICATION: scratch scripts evaluated each compute with check_compute.build_env on its handling-time world; figures above. Full gate block: all OK except check_traceability on unlock tool names before the KB is rendered.

Residual realism notes: the redraw schedule add-ons, the card convenience percentage and the card surcharge state lists are Larkspur's own published schedules (policy params); the lock relock fee 526.07 stays on the lock cost balance.

Round 4: dd scoped to per diem overcharge filings (R3-P1, R3-P2); its late-funding branch and type factor are gone, replaced by the standing-days rule (disbursement after / within / before the charge); the refund per standing day now measures against the per diem the note supports; the dispute refund row records the disputed charge's daily amount; rw's relock tier reads the lock's expiration before any relock (latest extension, else the original expiration); rd states why its not-in-schedule stamp is a partial reversal; fm/rd/dd baselines state their default zeros. No scored value changed.

Round 5: fm's flat 'card convenience percentage' sentence removed, so the state ladder (fall-through card_convenience_pct) is the only statement; the channel charge is scoped to funding-month interest; dd's replacement now states only the per diem overcharge recompute and that late-funding, closing-fee and returned-wire disputes remain under the base dispute rule; fm, rd and dd baselines state the standard figure without pointing at other rules. No scored value changed.

Round 6: dd's replacement restates the late-funding branch it retires (a late-funding dispute is decided, not by the per diem overcharge recompute, but by recomputing prepaid interest under the per diem policy as the late-funding refund applies it, any excess refunded as refund_issued), so every dispute type has exactly one in-force rule; closing-fee and returned-wire disputes stay under the base rule's own sentences. Probe: a pending late_funding filing on a task-0-like closing is not decided by dd's recompute (0.00) and the late-funding method gives 224.92. No scored value changed.

Round 7: fm's setoff per diem sentence no longer points to a dispute; the part of an open day's daily amount above the funding-month per diem 'is not set off and stays on the charge collected at closing'. No scored value changed.
user_scenario:
You are Theodore Vasquez, a high-school chemistry teacher who bought a townhouse at 5741 Tullymore Drive, Littleton, CO 80127 with a Larkspur VA loan together with your wife; you both signed electronically with a notary on September 16. You are friendly, a little wry, and you like things explained in plain numbers. On Friday, October 9, you filed a dispute with Larkspur about the prepaid interest on your closing, because the daily interest figure on your closing papers looked too high for your loan. You are calling to get that dispute decided today and to get back whatever you were overcharged. You want Larkspur to handle it; you are not asking for anything else.
You share details only when asked. Your phone number is 6145555736 and you usually give that first. To confirm your identity you give the last four digits of your Social Security number, 9126; if the agent needs one more detail, you give your date of birth, 1979-11-03. If asked which loan, you say the purchase of 5741 Tullymore Drive, Littleton, CO 80127. You do not know any Larkspur reference numbers and you do not know what the right daily figure should be. If the agent asks how you would pay anything, you say Larkspur can use the same credit card it has on file from your application.
If the agent tells you that something has to be booked on Larkspur's side first, you say that's fine and let them go ahead. If the agent tells you there is something you need to pay yourself, you ask what it is for, accept the explanation, and then pay it straight away with exactly the figures and dates the agent gives you, telling the agent once it shows as done. If asked whether to do it today, you say today. You never suggest numbers of your own and you do not argue with the figures the agent quotes. Once the agent tells you the dispute has been decided and your refund is booked, you thank them and hang up.
